question: Which of the following football club won the Indian Super League in March 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ATK FC.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Two times Champions,** ATK** won the final after **defeating Chennayin by 3–1.**
 
• ATK Football Club won the Indian Super League** 2019-2020**.
 
• ATK was an** Indian professional football club in Kolkata, West Bengal.**
 
• ATK FC was establish in **May 2014**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chennaiyin Football Club** is an Indian professional football club found in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**.
 
• **Football Club Goa** is an Indian professional football club found in** Goa.**
 
• **Bengaluru Football Club** is an Indian professional football club found in Bengaluru**, Karnataka.** ​
